notes.title: Isoland: Past and Present
notes.content:
If you want to spend your time constructively, why not read a book--or, you know, play more Isoland! That’s why Cotton Game is bringing you “Everything About Isoland”, a diary of “the youthful years”…

“Everything About Isoland” was produced by the makers of “Isoland” and “Isoland 2 – Ashes of Time”. In this book, Cotton Game discusses the spirit of Isoland, its past and present, and, best of all, shares Cotton Game’s own story with all of its puzzle-loving fans.

	Each of the eight chapters in the diary contains hidden clues. At the end of the book, players can enter these clues to unlock achievements and Easter eggs. The diary also includes tips to help players finish “Isoland” and “Isoland 2 – Ashes of Time”.

Dear Iso-lovers,
Thanks for all your support, we dedicate this book to
The people who created these stories
The people who travelled with us on this journey
The people who have loved and enjoyed these games
Cotton Game

notes.title: Sound settings unresponsiveness bug fixed
notes.content:
Thank you for following Isoland 2 - Ashes of Time. This update features the following optimizations:

2.  Improved the quality of Steam screenshots
3.  Optimized the pen tablet drawing function
